newsitem.title: USA: Hanover Direct to cut 550 jobs, sees charge.
newsitem.headline: Hanover Direct to cut 550 jobs, sees charge.

text.p: Hanover Direct Inc on Friday said it was cutting 550 jobs and would accrue a one-time charge related to its efforts to lower costs by $50 million next year.

The direct mail marketer said it expected its revenue to decline by 14 percent in 1997, since it was discontinuing some catalogs. For the first nine months of 1996, Hanover Direct reported a $51.7 million loss on sales of $502.5 million.
Revenues from continuing catalogs are expected to show little change next year.

Hanover Direct said fixed overhead reductions of $16 million include the shutdown of excess telemarketing capacity in the company's Roanoke, Va., facilities and excess warehousing capacity in its Hanover, Pa. facilities.

The marketing cost reductions of $21 million will be driven by elimination of unprofitable circulation and improved customer retention and target segmentation, but does not contemplate the shutdown of any of the current core catalogs.
The company is consolidating management for its general merchandise, Home Fashions-upscale and women's apparel divisions to lower costs, Hanover Direct said.
Also, Hanover Direct said it received a $30 million letter of credit from Richemont Finance SA, an affiliate of the company's majority shareholder.
Also, the company's bank lender dropped the minimum net worth requirement on its credit facility to $70 million from $80 million.
Hanover Direct said its fourth-uarter demand continues to be strong with the help of its Domestications and Company Store units, but backorders are higher than expected.
Delays in vendor shipments many not help the company achieve the positive earnings before interest and taxes that the company had figured before any restructuring charges, Hanover Direct said.
Hanover Direct said its catalog venture with Sears, Roebuck and Co has been terminated, but it does not expect the termination to have a material impact on its 1997 earnings.
Further details were not immediately available.
